name: Out-of-Kernel Compaction (OfK-Compact)
definition: A compaction method where InK-Compact is wrapped in a global kernel and called when data needs to be compacted, mimicking the usage pattern of Thrust and Chag::PP.
summary: Out-of-Kernel Compaction removes invalid rays by invoking host-side library functions after rendering, offering simpler implementation at the cost of synchronization overhead compared to in-kernel methods.
